text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Buena Vista was injured, I took 
her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Sorry for worrying you...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine with this. No worries.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, you're still as much of a 
worrywart as ever.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even back then, whenever I got hurt, you'd 
always get so frantic for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Didn't you ever rush to get a 
band-aid, and end up falling over 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! Both of us got injured together, 
and things were such a mess after that, 
weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Still, compared to back then...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You were so calm and collected today. You 
brought me all the way here right away.
choice_data_list:
Things are... different from back then, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Can we get back to training now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"We're not the same as we were back then. 
We won't let a single injury stop us."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if something happens, 
you'll be there to save me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So... what do you think? Of course, I'll 
make sure not to push myself too hard.
choice_data_list:
It'll be too late once something happens. 
Let's rest for now.

Got it. Let's keep at it without overdoing 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even a minor injury cannot be ignored. I 
thoroughly explained the situation, 
including the risk of it worsening.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Instead of relying completely 
on you, I need to get my act together 
first.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest quietly today. I'll get better 
right away, so please wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch. It might still hurt a little bit.
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for being so demanding. For 
now, I'll focus on resting."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, as long as I move slowly, the 
injury doesn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for indulging my stubborn 
request. I'll push through and overcome 
this, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Buena Vista gradually resumed her 
training.
